title: La Hípica
goal: Watch the horse parade and understand what is being shown off
culture: The Hípica is a parade of horses, and every horse in it belongs to somebody the crowd can name. Whose it is and where it is from is half the conversation and all of the point.

beats.es: (Van pasando los caballos, uno detrás de otro, brillando.)
beats.good: The horses are the point and whose they are is the second question everybody in the crowd is asking.

beats.es: De las fincas. Ese es de don Alberto, el de Nandaime.
beats.good: Ese es de — that one belongs to. Every horse in the parade belongs to a name, and half the pleasure of watching is knowing them.
Qué bonito, on its own, about a horse. It is the complete and correct thing to say and nothing more is needed.

beats.es: Todos los años igual. Nunca falla.
beats.good: Todos los años — every year. The calendar here is fixed and heavy, and this is the parade that closes the patron saint’s fiestas.
